[LTHE.4.3] Lowering compiles to the existing timestamp idiom:
for each consecutive `A then B within T` step,
`B.ts > A.ts and B.ts - A.ts < T`. When `latest`
is present, the compiler adds, after the sequence's last join, a negated
condition: no `A′` with `A.ts < A′.ts` that excludes `A` under [LTHE.2.5.3] —
equivalent to selecting, per match of the
followers, the maximum-ts anchor that precedes them. The construct needs no engine
machinery beyond the `latest` pruning; it uses
the same Rete joins and the same `ts`
semantics. Pure surface form with minimal runtime
surface.
